home.heroTitle: The Future of Medicine, Led by Youth
home.heroSubtitle: Empowering the next generation of medical professionals through premium competitive events, high-impact resources, and global healthcare fundraising.

about.mission: To inspire, educate, and mobilize students toward careers in healthcare and medicine, while driving high-impact fundraising for global health equity.
about.vision: A global community of young medical innovators, advocates, and leaders working together to break down barriers in medical education and healthcare delivery.

values.title: Academic Excellence
values.description: Fostering rigorous research, critical analysis, and hands-on learning in the biological and medical sciences.

values.title: Global Compassion
values.description: Directing student talent and energy toward real-world healthcare disparities and humanitarian aid.

values.title: Inclusive Leadership
values.description: Providing equitable access to medical extracurriculars, mentorship, and leadership roles for all students.

about.financialStatement: At YMA, transparency is a core value. We ensure that the maximum amount of every dollar raised goes directly to clinical care, medical supply distribution, and healthcare research through our partner organizations. We maintain a zero-compensation policy for our student board.

competitions.introduction: YMA competitive events allow aspiring medical students to test their clinical reasoning, diagnostics, and bio-innovation skills. We offer three primary competitions annually, judged by medical board advisors and clinical professionals.

schedule.title: National Medical Case Competition
schedule.description: Analyze a complex multi-system clinical patient presentation, diagnose the underlying conditions, and defend a comprehensive treatment plan before a panel of physicians.

schedule.title: National Anatomy & Physiology Bowl
schedule.description: An intensive, fast-paced tournament testing core physiological systems, anatomical identification, and clinical diagnostic correlations.

schedule.title: Bio-Innovation & Health Summit
schedule.description: Design a hardware or software prototype addressing a critical gap in global public health, telemedicine, or clinical diagnostic efficiency.

winners.project: Atypical Cardiac Presentation in Geriatric Patients
winners.description: Formulated a multi-drug diagnostic protocol for asymptomatic coronary thrombosis in high-risk demographics, winning first place out of 230 teams.

winners.project: Low-Cost Microfluidic Paper Diagnostics for Rural Clinics
winners.description: Created a functional, dry-reagent paper assay capable of diagnosing bacterial vs. viral infections for less than $0.15 per test card.

impact.introduction: We channel student-led engagement into direct global change. Every competition entry fee and corporate sponsorship contributes to our global health fund, distributed directly to validated healthcare initiatives.

partners.name: Doctors Without Borders
partners.description: Funding emergency mobile health clinics in remote zones facing disease outbreaks and surgical shortages.

partners.name: Local Pediatric Care Funds
partners.description: Providing advanced diagnostic monitors and therapeutic toys to local children's hospital oncology wards.

partners.name: UNICEF Child Health Initatives
partners.description: Sponsoring childhood vaccination campaigns and clean water access in rural school districts.

sponsorship.introduction: Partner with YMA to foster pre-medical innovation and showcase your brand to thousands of future healthcare professionals, researchers, and university leaders.

tiers.name: Bronze Partner
features: Logo displayed on our competition pages
Acknowledge in the event opening ceremony
Distributed digital handouts in registration packets

tiers.name: Silver Partner
features: Dedicated logo spot in the email newsletters
Invitation to host a 15-minute webinar during summits

tiers.name: Gold Partner
features: Premium logo placement on homepage and event banners
Named sponsor of a specific competition category (e.g. Physiology Track)

roles.requirements: Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and basic accounting knowledge.

roles.title: Marketing & Media Coordinator
roles.description: Design visual assets and craft engaging copy to promote YMA competitive events and chapter milestones.
